title: Provider health shared across engine, delegate and eval; breaker for repeated unavailable failures
summary: provider_health.py owns the machine-wide cooldown file the engine already used (engine keeps alias names). Added: reset parsing for observed messages and Retry-After; a failure-window breaker (3 unavailable in 10 min -> 15 min cooldown, half-open by expiry); delegate/eval skip cooling providers, record cooldowns on quota/unavailable, and return 'unroutable' with deferred_until instead of silently spending on blocked providers. Evaluated: EVR-0012 (EVS-ROUTING noninferior), state-machine hunt 20 x 50 ops with unavailable bursts, 0 violations.

prior_art.checked: PA-pybreaker, PA-tenacity (fresh), existing engine cooldown code
prior_art.found: breaker state machine (pybreaker) already subsumed in retry.py; the engine already had quota cooldowns
prior_art.reused: existing engine cooldown file and routing filter; pybreaker closed/open/half-open semantics (half-open realized as cooldown expiry)
